title: Glessner's 18th Street monogram, as the 1965 photograph shows it
items: The Glessner House's north chimney stone above the 1886 date now carries the joined monogram HABS photograph 14 shows: two outward-facing bowls, each closed by a stem, joined by a bar at mid-height. It replaces the plain letters AD set in a stock typeface.
The device is drawn at the photograph's own proportions on the stone: about 0.43 of its width and half its height, centred. The weight of each stroke is reconstructed and recorded as a liberty.
